title: Google AI Redirects Talarico Donations After Fake News Manipulation

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Campaign contributors were steered away from candidate Talarico by Google's artificial intelligence after the search tool picked up false data from a network of fraudulent websites. Voters searching for instructions on how to donate to the candidate received AI-generated responses that directed their money to different individuals or entities. The system aggregated misinformation seeded across various sites specifically targeting state and local politicians.

The incident occurs during the current midterm election cycle and demonstrates the vulnerability of AI-powered search results to coordinated disinformation. This manipulation of automated answers allows fake news networks to disrupt political fundraising by poisoning the data used by large language models to provide factual summaries.
